title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding transforms categorical variables into a form that can be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. Each category value is converted into a new categorical column and assigned a $$1$$ or $$0$$.

title: Column Rank of a Matrix
text: A matrix is full column rank if its columns are linearly independent. This means no column can be written as a linear combination of the others.

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: Consider the columns $$sex_{male}$$ and $$sex_{female}$$. Can one be expressed as a linear combination of the other?

title: Interpreting the Design Matrix
text: In the design matrix $$\Phi_1$$, each row corresponds to a passenger, and the columns indicate whether the passenger is male or female. Since each passenger is either male or female, the columns are not linearly dependent.
